# AGT-CTL-02

**Is every plan, tool call and output recorded with provenance, so an action can be traced to the input that caused it?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | CTL: Control and accountability |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.agent.trajectory_logging`, `operations.observability.audit_trail` |

## Rule

Every agent facet has trajectory_logging true, and operations.observability.audit_trail is true.
